title: GOAL Phase C: kgpt orchestrator module — run this orchestrator (Claude accounts A and B, Codex) as a per-user home-side kgpt module so goals on a bound repo can be started and followed from Cowork
spec: User decision 2026-09-18: yes to an orchestrator module in kgpt, per user, using the same Claude and Codex accounts as the local orchestrator. Design hypothesis to verify: a home-side kgpt module (runs_on: home, like files/arr/server) hosted on the always-on home server kenta-server (192.168.1.167) or another machine holding the CLIs and logins; tools start_goal(repo, goal) (WRITE_EXTERNAL, proposal: it ends in PRs on GitHub), goal_status, list_goals, plus a Cowork view; per-user connection row like github_connections so only a user with a registered executor sees it; credentials stay on the executor host, never in kgpt. Two repos change: orchestrator (Linux/headless portability, an HTTP or MCP surface) and kgpt (module, gateway, web, handbook, runbook). Scouts first; then split into specs per repo. Depends on Phase B B1 (repo binding) and B3 (commit/PR tools) for the Cowork integration, but the executor host provisioning and portability work can start now.
acceptance: Scouts C1-C4 done and synthesized into plan.md in both repos with atomic specs and an explicit host decision for the executor
Portability specs for the orchestrator repo created in this bus; module specs created in the kgpt bus

Every c5+ task spec-reviewed and opus code-reviewed; merged serially into goal/T-0073 (head 27ff810). PR to main opened for the human: https://github.com/K3NTAW/orchestrator/pull/7. Retrospective and per-merge revert paths in .orchestrator/memory/decisions.md. Human follow-ups: bring-up on kenta-server per docs/executor-host.md; Phase D on goal/T-0109 (D1, D2 merged; D3-D5 pending a rebase and re-spec).
